notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Undercity Scrounger.
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has died this turn.
description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
Repeat.
